description.value: Finger tapping under externally-paced and self-paced conditions, requiring maintenance of a regular 1500 ms beat over 50 taps.

spans.text: The current study examined motor timing in frontotemporal dementia (FTD)
Conditions were presented in fixed order (externally-paced followed by self-paced).
The experimental test was administered under Superlab© on a Dell OptiPlex 960 computer.

instructions.value: Participants were instructed to tap in pace with tones and, in the self-paced condition, continue tapping after the tones ceased.

spans.text: Participants were instructed to use the index finger of their dominant hand to tap in pace with these tones
Tone stimuli were presented in free field
The timing of finger taps was recorded using a Cedrus  RB-730 Response Pad.

For each participant for each task, we assessed the following performance measures: inter-response interval (IRI), inter-response interval variance, clock variance, motor variance, response interval drift and response interval absolute drift.
